result:
**Verdict: GO.** N1 is resolved. The delta doesn't reopen B1, B2 or M1–M5, and I found no new blocker.

## N1 resolution check

- **Hash meaning is kept.** `compiler-core-v2.ts:1335` computes `dependenciesHash: sha256CanonicalJson(dependencies)`. CN-166-P1 (around line 127) now says this hash changes and that classification must not be excluded from existing hash material. The design (§7, around line 244) says the same: "Existing hash material is not weakened."
- **The "manifest bytes unchanged" claim holds.** I checked the code to see whether a new field on `OccurrenceMediaResolutionV2` could reach the manifest:
  - Manifest sources (line 1389) copy only named fields: `mediaReferenceId`, `sourceSnapshot.contentHash/probeHash`, `sourceFrameMap`, `preparedMediaRequirementKey`.
  - Event provenance (lines 454 and 723) uses `descriptor.sourceSnapshot.contentHash`.
  - `preparationBindingHash` and `deliveredSourceId` (lines 456, 864 and 921) hash the `preparedMedia` binding, not the resolution.
  - Nothing hashes or spreads the whole resolution object into the manifest.
  - The proposed `graphicProvenanceHash` on manifest events applies only to derived content, so `legacy_unclassified` adds nothing to the manifest.
  - Since the manifest bytes don't change, the report's `manifest.contentHash` (line 1335) doesn't change either.
- **Report hash effects are stated outright.** CN-166-P1, the design (around lines 244 and 267–269) and the inbox (around lines 31–34) all say that `dependenciesHash` and anything hashed over the report will change. I found no new diagnostic for `legacy_unclassified`, so no other report field is implicated.
- **Frozen originals are kept.** "Retain original frozen fixtures/goldens unchanged as accepted historical evidence" appears in CN-166-P1 (line 163) and the design (line 267).
- **Migrated copies and accepted-test changes are named and kept narrow.**
  - The three stems are named under `tests/data/authoring_v2/issue_173/compiler/`: `visual-only-graphic-still-ntsc-default`, `-25fps-default` and `-ntsc-override`.
  - The only accepted-test change allowed is the graphic branch of the media-backed visual-only-kind test in `compiler-v2.test.ts`, and only after approval: unmigrated inputs must refuse and migrated copies must compile.
  - Image/capture and all unrelated cases keep their bytes.
  - Any further fixture or test found on the actual implementation baseline needs a revised note before it is touched. That is the right fallback.
- **No stale claims remain.** A search for the old "legacy goldens remain / byte-identical / manifest/report bytes" wording finds only the corrected v1-only and unaffected-v2 statements.
- **The delta changes docs only.** It touches the design, CN-166-P1, dispositions and the inbox. No runtime, schema, fixture, golden or test file is in it.

## S1 and #218

- **S1 is consistent with B1.** Existing templates that aren't EV24 stay on the pre-provenance media-only path with no derived-evidence claim. New-format content that isn't EV24 blocks until its own contract is approved. A declared derived revision is never downgraded to legacy. This doesn't loosen B1's rule that `legacy_unclassified` may come only from storage positively identified as the pre-provenance format.
- **#218's acceptance text matches CN-166-P1:** v1 goldens unchanged, explicitly approved v2 migrated copies, and the inbox checklist item.

## Optional suggestions (not blockers)

1. In CN-166-P1's migrated-copy paragraph, say that migrated inputs keep `build.buildId/reportId`, `document` and every other dependency field identical. Then the only allowed report differences are exactly `dependenciesHash` plus any hash taken over the report.
2. "Transitive hash changes" could say plainly that nothing *inside* the v2 report is derived from `dependenciesHash`. Only external hashes over the report bytes change.

## Limitations

- I used only Read/Grep/Glob on the supplied packet, with no execution and no network.
- Fixture and test files aren't in the packet, so I can't confirm that the three stems exist on main or that they are the only affected v2 graphic cases. The proposal's "enumerate on the implementation baseline and seek a revised note" clause covers that risk.
- I confirmed #218's body only from the retained inbox text.
- This GO covers the design proposal's wording only. It is not approval of any runtime, schema, fixture or golden change, and nothing executable or frozen is authorized here.
